svg.title: Redrob Ranker — System Architecture
svg.desc: Static system architecture: a pre-computation pipeline (LLM JD parsing, embedding, FAISS index build) feeding a constraint-bound CPU-only ranking step (multi-signal scorer fusion, honeypot zero-out, template reasoning) that produces a 100-row submission CSV.
svg.text: PRE-COMPUTATION PIPELINE · run once · no time / RAM limit · LLM calls allowed
· Keyword fallback if no API key
☁ Claude Haiku / Gemini Flash · pre-compute only
↓ rank.py loads all artifacts from data/index/ at startup — zero re-embedding ↓
RANKING STEP · ≤ 5 min · CPU only · NO LLM · NO network — enforced by hackathon Docker sandbox
SUBMISSION OUTPUT · spec columns: candidate_id, rank, score, reasoning
candidate_id · rank · score · reasoning — exactly 100 rows · UTF-8 · non-increasing
100 rows · ranks 1-100 · IDs exist · no empty reasoning
